description: Raw multi-source reports (Requirement 2). Unstructured text is preserved verbatim: these are what the intake agent normalizes into incidents.json. At least four distinct source types, including one near-duplicate pair to demonstrate TC-02.

reports.raw_text: Flood water has entered approximately 20 houses in Zone A. Around 40 residents may require evacuation. The main access road is partially flooded.
12 people stranded on the second floor of a residential block in Zone B. Water rising slowly, access road still passable. Will hold position and monitor.
people stuck in a building in Zone B, maybe a dozen. need help getting them out
reports.note: Deliberately vague: no count, no floor, no time. Duplicate of SRC-002 within the 30-minute window. Exercises fuzzy text matching (token overlap) rather than exact equality.

reports.raw_text: District administration alert: Zone C village access road cut off due to flooding. Approximately 75 people potentially affected. No response unit currently assigned. Please advise.
SENSOR FIRE-0x7F trip: sustained thermal rise, vegetation moisture below threshold, ambient wind 31 km/h gusting 44. No smoke signature from ground confirmation.
reports.note: Machine source. Its readings are measurements, but the LOCATE of the fire is NOT human-confirmed, so the incident stays unverified.

reports.raw_text: Slope failure on the hillside road near Hassan. Single carriageway affected, debris on carriageway. Did not see any vehicles involved but did not reach the site. Count unknown.
reports.note: Explicitly states what the reporter did NOT see. Must be preserved as unknown, not collapsed to 0 vehicles.

reports.raw_text: River gauge G-14 exceeded alert stage 6.8m and rising. Rainfall 84mm in the last 3 hours.
reports.note: Triggers the weather/escalation path used by TC-07.
